description: On the table there’s an open black case, a small plush toy, a gray glasses-style case, and a couple of small white round items. The right hand reaches to pick up a small white item and places it into the open black case, then lifts the gray case and puts that in too; next the right hand scoops the plush toy into the case, brings the lid down, and both hands press at the front edge to latch it shut.
